title: 啊 and 呢: softer, livelier tone
summary: Lets you sound warmer and more natural with 啊, and stress something is happening now with 呢.
explanation:
啊 at the end adds feeling and makes speech warmer: 好啊！'Sure!', 天气真好啊！'What lovely weather!' In questions it softens the tone: 你去哪儿啊？

呢 has several jobs. After a statement it shows something is still going on: 他在睡觉呢 'He's (still) asleep.' After a noun it asks 'what about…?': 我很好，你呢？ It also softens question-word questions: 你在哪儿呢？

examples.en: I'm a student. What about you?

mistakes.why: Use one question word at the end, not 呢 and 吗 together.
This 啊 of feeling goes at the end of the sentence.

why: 你吧 would be a guess, not 'and you?'

exercises.prompt: Your friend asks you to go to the cinema. You happily agree:
why: 好吗 asks 'OK?' instead of agreeing.
好呢 doesn't sound like agreeing.

exercises.instruction: Add 'still / right now' feeling with 呢.
why: 呢 goes at the end here.
Don't add 吗 after 呢.

exercises.why: 啊 adds feeling at the very end.

why: Correct: 啊 softens a question-word question.
哪儿 already asks; don't add 吗.
Correct: thing + 呢？ asks where it is.
